title: The text is a series of letters addressed to Agony Aunt Temi Peters, a relationship and marriage counselor. The writers of the letters are seeking advice on various issues related to love, relationships, and marriage. One writer is looking for a suitable lover, while another is unhappy with their spouse's lack of interest in sex. A third writer is in love with a Nigerian woman but has been unsuccessful in winning her back, despite trying to date other women. The writer is torn between their love for the Nigerian woman and their desire to be with someone who is more responsive to their advances. The letters are respectful and honest, but also reveal some cultural and societal norms and biases.
